name: ecb-europa
description: ECB Data Portal (data.ecb.europa.eu): search European Central Bank statistical series (HICP inflation, exchange rates, SPF forecasts and more), fetch a series' observations as JSON, and pull raw data from the public ECB SDMX REST API.

commands.name: get-series-observations
commands.summary: Get the observations (period, value, unit, trend, status) of one ECB series by its full series key, e.g. HICP.M.U2.N.SERV00.4D0.ANR

params.name: series_key
params.description: Full series key: DATASET.dim1.dim2... For example HICP.M.U2.N.SERV00.4D0.ANR (euro area services inflation), EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A (daily USD/EUR rate) or SPF.Q.U2.HICP.POINT.LT.Q.AVG.

commands.name: search-series
commands.summary: Keyword search for ECB data series, optionally filtered by concept tag; returns links to series detail pages that contain the series keys

params.name: layerType
params.description: Result layer: KL = key series, DL = data layer (all series), AL = all layers

params.name: tag
params.description: Concept/tag filter as shown in the facet list, e.g. 'Services'

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based page index (0 = first page, 1 = second page)

commands.name: get-sdmx-data
commands.summary: Download series data as CSV from the public ECB SDMX REST API (data-api.ecb.europa.eu); supports wildcard keys and period filters

params.name: dataset
params.description: Dataflow id, e.g. EXR, HICP, SPF

params.name: key
params.description: Series key without the dataset prefix. Dimensions are dot-separated; leave a dimension empty for wildcard and join several values with '+', e.g. M.USD+GBP.EUR.SP00.A

params.name: startPeriod
params.description: Start period: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: endPeriod
params.description: End period, same formats as startPeriod

params.name: lastNObservations
params.description: Return only the last N observations of each series

commands.name: list-dataflows
commands.summary: List all ECB dataflows (dataset ids, names and their data structure ids) from the SDMX REST API

commands.name: get-data-structure
commands.summary: Get the SDMX data structure definition (dimensions, concepts and code lists) for a dataset, e.g. ECB_EXR1 for EXR

params.name: dsd_id
params.description: Data structure definition id, as returned by list-dataflows (str:Structure.Ref.@id), e.g. ECB_EXR1 (EXR), ECB_ICP1 (HICP)

notes: All endpoints are public and need no login.

get-series-observations returns a JSON array of observations, newest first. OBS is the rounded display value and OBS_VALUE_AS_IS is the full-precision value. PERIOD is a UTC timestamp of the period start; PERIOD_NAME is human-readable.

Series key pattern for HICP: HICP.{freq M/A}.{area: U2=euro area, DE, FR, IT, ...}.N.{item: 000000=all items, SERV00=services, NRGY00=energy, FOOD00=food, XEF000=core, IGXE00=non-energy industrial goods, 040000=housing...}.4D0.{ANR=annual rate | INX=index}.
Series key pattern for exchange rates: EXR.{D/M/A}.{currency}.EUR.SP00.A, e.g. EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A.
Search results pages are zero-based: page=1 is the second page. Result links have the form /data/datasets/{DATASET}/{SERIES_KEY}; pass the last path segment to get-series-observations.

The SDMX commands (get-sdmx-data, list-dataflows, get-data-structure) use the documented public API at data-api.ecb.europa.eu. Their XML responses are converted to JSON and can be large; prefer detail/lastNObservations to limit size.
Not captured: the geographical-area and dataset filters, the sort order of search results, and the data-cart and currency-converter actions (the converter runs only in the browser).
